items.quote: Rather than simply deploying tools, we could consult from the design stage on how to safely and efficiently manage research data. They resolved complex requirements unique to academic institutions from both technical and operational angles.

We had no AI experts internally and were lost on where to begin. UNCHAIN respected our 90-year-old workflows while clearly identifying priorities — 'AI-ify this area for maximum impact' — enabling smooth adoption.

Integrating existing systems used by craftsmen with cutting-edge AI is something most IT vendors can't relate to. They understood our messy field-level challenges and drew an 'implementation blueprint' for factory system integration.
Hardware-AI integration is notoriously difficult, but with their R&D background serving as a technical sparring partner, we've been running from PoC to implementation at maximum speed.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.a1: No. We produce workflow guides, prompts and internal briefing material, and support setup over screen share. Production operation and approvals stay with your team. System development and PoC implementation are out of scope.
faq.q2: Can we start without an AI lead?
faq.a2: Yes. The service assumes you have no dedicated AI lead. The first session maps your current state and priorities, then breaks the work down into steps the owner or your point person can run.
faq.q3: Will our information go into external AI?
faq.a3: No confidential information goes into external AI without your approval. We agree the scope up front and document which tools may be used and what may be entered.
faq.a4: Yes. We cover operational questions such as AI usage rules, permissions, logging and internal approval flow. Audit response itself and system implementation work are out of scope.
faq.q5: How is this different from consulting or training?
faq.a5: We work alongside you on a regular cadence, advancing decisions and execution every time. Rather than a one-off proposal deck or a lecture, we settle the next move and review its results next session.
faq.q6: Will you push a particular tool on us?
faq.a6: We are not a reseller for any vendor. Tools are compared on business requirements and cost, and “do not adopt it” is a recommendation we will make.
faq.q7: Can we sign an NDA first?
faq.a7: Yes. We are happy to sign before any discussion, on your paper or ours. Just let us know before the free consultation.
faq.q8: Can we pause or change partway through?
faq.a8: Yes. Plans can be changed or paused month to month, so you can adjust the depth of support as your structure changes.
faq.q9: What industries and workflows do you cover?
faq.a9: We do not restrict by industry. Most engagements start with document-and-information work: meeting minutes, quote and proposal drafts, manual revisions, inbound enquiries and tidying internal material.
faq.a10: We recommend the decision maker plus the people who actually do the work. The Executive plan suits 1-2 executives, the Department plan one team of up to 10, and the Company-wide plan leadership together with each department lead.
faq.q11: What does chat support cover, and how fast do you reply?
faq.a11: It covers questions about the themes under your contract. Replies come within 2 business days as a rule on the Executive plan, and within 1 business day on the Department and Company-wide plans, during weekday business hours. Scope and hours are stated in the contract.
faq.q12: Can you work with us other than online?
faq.a12: Regular sessions run online as a rule. We also visit in person where it helps, such as training or a kick-off. Visit frequency and who covers the cost are agreed individually at contract time.
faq.q13: Could our advisor change partway through?
faq.a13: Each client is assigned a lead advisor, and as a rule the same person continues throughout. If a change is unavoidable, the reasoning and execution status are handed over within the team.
faq.q14: How do you handle personal and confidential information?
faq.a14: We use what you share only as far as the work requires, and handle it under the terms of the NDA. Where personal or confidential information would go into an external AI, we agree the scope in advance and never enter anything unapproved. Where material is stored and who may access it are also agreed at contract time.
faq.q15: How many months is the contract?
faq.a15: The minimum term is three months, so the first three months can run a full cycle of mapping, trial and impact review. From the fourth month you continue month to month.
faq.q16: Are there any costs beyond the monthly fee?
faq.a16: There is no setup fee. The monthly fee covers regular sessions, chat support and the deliverables. AI tool licences, travel for on-site visits, and any work beyond the contracted scope are quoted before we begin.
faq.q17: Can we use the deliverables freely inside our company?
faq.a17: Yes. Deliverables produced within your contract are yours to use freely inside your company. Please ask us first if you need to redistribute or resell them externally.
